{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.76

|gr1= Roads and Airports

|descr= Returns all map airports, both static and dynamic.

|s1= [[allAirports]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [staticAirports, dynamicAirports]
